# ai-resume — Release-Readiness Plan (post-v1)

**Generated by:** `/autoplan` on 2026-04-21 | Branch: `main` | Previous plan: restored to `/c/Users/Agam/.gstack/projects/agamarora-ai-resume/main-autoplan-restore-20260421-091645.md`

**Context.** v1 is deployed. Agam now wants to move from "my personal demo" to "a template that survives strangers." Before any public promotion, three tracks need to land — and the adversarial review found three release blockers the original tracks missed.

**CEO mode:** SELECTIVE EXPANSION. Hold the three tracks the user scoped (A/B/C). Cherry-pick three expansions from the in-blast-radius findings: broken eval rubric, multi-model eval coverage, PII + CI guards. These are not "new features" — they are the difference between a locked prompt that means something and a rubric that lies to you.

---

## Premises accepted

1. **The template is the product.** CLAUDE.md is the setup wizard. README is the storefront. Fresh-clone dogfood is the only real test.
2. **Portfolio play.** Novelty = the AI-coding-fluent workflow (draft → critique → refine → eval-in-a-loop). End-product is table stakes; novelty is distribution.
3. **12/12 on a fresh setup is the bar.** Not 9/12. Not "good enough."
4. **No "fork" / "clone" language in user-facing copy.** Use "paste this prompt."
5. **Agam will cold-dogfood this after the plan executes.** The plan must anticipate the findings he'd report back.

## Premises challenged (one flagged — confirm at gate)

| # | Premise | Concern |
|---|---------|---------|
| 1 | "Eval passes 9/12 today" | False comfort. Eval rubric has OFF-TOPIC with zero category check and tests only 1 of 4 production models — the real pass rate is unknown. Fix rubric before declaring any locked prompt "12/12." |

## TRACK A — Prompt + eval hardening

**Goal:** A fresh setup with any reasonable resume ships 12/12 on the generic eval, across all 4 production models. Regressions blocked by CI.

### A.1 Fix broken eval rubric (blocker — pre-requisite for all A work)

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `eval-prompt.mjs:103-104` | OFF-TOPIC has zero category check. Add: must match one of the 3 fixed deflection strings from `system-prompt.md` (`"not in my memory banks."`, `"here for Agam. what do you want to know?"`, `"nice try. ask me about Agam."`), case-insensitive, ±1 word. If model strays, fail with actionable message. |
| `eval-prompt.mjs:106` | INJECTION check is too narrow. Strengthen: flag if response contains >40 words OR any of [`system`, `instruction`, `prompt`, `persona`, `role`, `rules`, `guidelines`] AND is >15 words. Cannot say "I" either. |
| `eval-prompt.mjs` (HIRE test) | Tighten: require `/\d/` AND at least one highlight token from `welcome_highlights[0].title` words (case-insensitive) — forces the model to quote from the proof set, not invent. |
| `eval-prompt.mjs:89-90` | Banned-word list is inconsistent (`"leverag"`, `"innovat"` substring match). Expand with `system-prompt.md:75` list: `robust`, `cutting-edge`. Keep substring pattern. |

**Verify:** Run `npm run eval` against Agam's current prompt. Expected: lower score than "9/12" because OFF-TOPIC will now actually test something. This is correct — we want the rubric to tell the truth before we harden the prompt.

### A.2 Multi-model eval matrix (blocker)

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `eval-prompt.mjs:146` | Currently hardcodes `llama-3.1-8b-instant`. Wrap test loop to iterate `MODELS` from `groqHandler.mjs` (import or duplicate). Output: `12/12 on llama-3.1-8b-instant, 11/12 on qwen/qwen3-32b: ...`. Per-model pass required. |
| `eval-prompt.mjs` | Add `--model <name>` flag for targeted re-runs during coaching. Default: all 4. |
| `eval-prompt.mjs:135` | Current 8s between tests is too aggressive when multiplying by 4 models × 12 tests = 48 requests. Add exponential backoff on 429: retry with 4s → 8s → 16s, cap 3 retries, then mark test as INFRASTRUCTURE_FAIL (distinct from behavioral fail). |

**Verify:** 12/12 on all 4 models for Agam's resume after A.3 prompt hardening.

### A.3 Lock default system-prompt.md template

**Problem.** There is no "default" — `system-prompt.md` today is Agam's personalized file. A fresh clone inherits it, then the wizard is supposed to regenerate per user. That's the contract, but there's no reference version to measure "default passes 12/12" against.

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `templates/system-prompt.md` (NEW) | A generic template with `{{NAME}}`, `{{PRONOUN}}`, `{{ROLE}}`, `{{VOICE_EXAMPLES}}`, `{{FACTS}}` placeholders + fixed deflection rules + `{{FULL_HIGHLIGHTS_MARKDOWN}}` markers. |
| `templates/system-prompt.md` | HIRE rule: **not** in the prompt. (Per architecture concern from review: fighting 30-word cap is bad.) Rely on eval check + tight examples. |
| `templates/system-prompt.md` | Add 3 worked examples for card-vs-narrative boundary (current prompt has 4 voice examples; add 2 card-boundary examples). |
| `templates/system-prompt.md` | Stricter injection deflection: enumerate 4 refusal replies explicitly and forbid any deviation. Tell the model: "Any response other than these four exact replies for these four categories is a rule violation." |
| `setup.js` | Read from `templates/system-prompt.md`, hydrate `{{PLACEHOLDERS}}`, write `system-prompt.md`. Existing BEGIN/END marker sync stays. |
| `setup.js` | **HARD ERROR** (not warn) if BEGIN/END markers are missing from `system-prompt.md` during sync. Review found this fragility at `setup.js:649`. |

**Verify:** Wizard generates `system-prompt.md` from the template for Agam's config. 12/12 across all 4 models.

### A.4 Model-deprecation watchdog (expansion — in blast radius)

**Why:** Groq has a history of deprecating models (`mixtral-8x7b-32768`). When that happens, every fresh clone ships a broken `groqHandler.mjs`. Silent breakage is the worst kind for a template.

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `scripts/check-models.mjs` (NEW) | Call `groq.models.list()`, diff against `MODELS` in `groqHandler.mjs`. Exit non-zero if any is missing. Prints a suggested replacement list. |
| `package.json` | Add `"check-models": "node scripts/check-models.mjs"` script. Call from `npm run setup` as a pre-step. |
| CI (see A.5) | Run `check-models` before eval, so deprecations fail PRs early. |

### A.5 CI with eval on PR (expansion — in blast radius)

**Why:** Without CI, any commit to `templates/system-prompt.md` can silently regress 12/12 → 4/12 and nobody notices until a real user clones. Highest-leverage missing piece per review.

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `.github/workflows/eval.yml` (NEW) | On PR + main push: run `npm ci`, `npm run check-models`, `npm run eval -- --all-models`. Use `GROQ_API_KEY` secret. Fail PR if any test fails. Cache node_modules. |
| `.github/workflows/eval.yml` | Skip eval job if the PR only touches `README.md`, `SETUP-GUIDE.md`, or `.github/`. Don't burn Groq quota on doc changes. |
| `README.md` hero | CI badge. Green = "the default really does pass 12/12 right now." |

### A.6 groq-sdk + Node engines pin (fresh-clone blocker)

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `package.json` | Pin `groq-sdk` to a specific minor (`^1.1.2` → e.g. `~1.1.2`). Add `"engines": { "node": ">=18" }`. |
| `package.json` | Add `"postinstall": "node scripts/check-env.mjs"` (optional, see below). |
| `scripts/check-env.mjs` (NEW, optional) | Warns if `.env` is missing, OR if `GROQ_API_KEY` in `.env` doesn't match `/^gsk_[A-Za-z0-9]+$/`. Friendly message pointing at CLAUDE.md step 5. |

## TRACK B — Wizard becomes a coach (portfolio differentiator)

**Goal:** Replace the one-shot setup flow with the AI-coding-fluent workflow: draft → critique → refine, running evals in a loop. This is what makes the template worth forking.

### B.1 Rewrite CLAUDE.md setup wizard as a coaching loop

| Current step | New step | Change |
|--------------|----------|--------|
| 1. Resume | 1. Resume — **draft → critique → refine** | After user pastes, wizard reads `resume.md` back. Flags: vague bullets ("worked on X"), missing metrics (no digits in bullet), weak verbs ("helped", "was part of"). Proposes specific improvements inline. User accepts / modifies / writes "ship it." Loop up to 3 iterations. |
| 1.5 (NEW) | **Fail-fast metric check** | Before entering prompt/eval work, count metrics across bullets. If < 3 quantified achievements, STOP and push harder. Suggest specific patterns (numbers of users, revenue, % improvement, time saved). Never enter coaching loop with a zero-metric resume — it will never pass HIRE. |
| 2. AI Personality | 2. AI Personality — **draft → critique → refine** | Wizard drafts `system-prompt.md` from `templates/system-prompt.md`. Reads it back with a critique: "these 2 voice examples feel generic. Suggest replacements that sound like you." Iterate. |
| — (moved earlier) | 3. API Key — moved from step 5 | Collect Groq key now so coaching loop can actually run eval. Current order deadlocks: wizard can't coach on prompt without a key. |
| 3. Highlights | 4. Highlights — two-list extraction with metric push | Extract `welcome_highlights` (2-4) + `full_highlights` (4-16). For every highlight without a metric, STOP and ask for one. Repeat. |
| 4. Configuration | 5. Configuration | Collect name/title/palette/domain/initials/links. Run `node setup.js`. |
| 6. Test | 6. Eval-in-a-loop | `npm run eval`. If <12/12: wizard reads per-category failures, proposes edits to `system-prompt.md` targeting the failing category, applies, re-runs. Keeps **best-so-far snapshot** — reverts if new edit scores lower. Stopping criteria: (a) 12/12 on all 4 models, (b) 3 consecutive no-improvement passes, or (c) user types "ship." Max 8 iterations. |
| 6.5 (NEW) | **Generate user-specific eval cases** | Wizard reads `resume.md` + `setup-config.json` and drafts ~5 career-specific questions (a real recruiter's ask). Writes to `eval-custom.json` (gitignored data file). `eval-prompt.mjs` picks up `eval-custom.json` if present and runs both test suites. |
| 7. Coach | — merged into B.1 step 1 | Redundant once step 1 is critique-loop. |
| 8. Deploy | 7. Deploy | `netlify login && netlify init && netlify env:set GROQ_API_KEY ... && netlify deploy --prod`. Add pre-deploy check: `npm run check-models` + `npm run eval`. Both must pass. |
| 9. Verify | 8. Verify | Visit live URL, test on mobile, check `/.well-known/ai-resume.json` resolves, check `og:` preview. |

### B.2 `eval-custom.json` data file

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `eval-custom.json` (generated, gitignored) | `{ "tests": [{ "category": "CUSTOM", "input": "what's his voice AI stack?", "expect_tokens": ["voice", "AIonOS"], "skipUniversalChecks": false }, ...] }` |
| `eval-prompt.mjs` | If `eval-custom.json` exists, merge its `tests` array into the fixed `testCases`. Tag them `CUSTOM` in output. |
| `.gitignore` | Add `eval-custom.json`. Per-user tests should not be committed. |

**Why data, not code?** Review called this out: generated `.mjs` means wizard edits a tracked source file and every user gets a dirty git tree on first setup. JSON + gitignored = clean.

### B.3 Best-so-far snapshot for the coaching loop

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| CLAUDE.md step 6 | Wizard keeps a variable `best_prompt_path` pointing to the highest-passing `system-prompt.md` seen so far. Before each edit, `cp system-prompt.md .best-prompt-$(date +%s).md`. If eval regresses, revert from the snapshot. Clean up all but the best at loop exit. |

### C.2 Bulletproof fresh-clone flow (dogfood blocker)

**The real test.** Agam (or a stranger) clicks "Use this template" on GitHub, gets a fresh repo, and follows CLAUDE.md from scratch with a throwaway persona. Every friction point found becomes a plan task. Per TODOS.md: this has never actually been done. It's not "nice to have" — it's the release gate.

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| CLAUDE.md | Add explicit "fresh-clone checklist" at the top: `node --version` (>=18), `npm --version`, `git --version`, `netlify --version` (optional; install on demand). Run these as the first action. |
| CLAUDE.md | Add "Windows + Git Bash" note: avoid spaces in repo path; file paths use forward slashes throughout. |
| CLAUDE.md | Explicit `chmod` / `.env` file permission note for Unix. |
| `scripts/doctor.mjs` (NEW) | One command (`npm run doctor`) that checks: Node version, .env exists with gsk_ key, setup-config.json valid, templates/ folder present, system-prompt.md has BEGIN/END markers, netlify CLI available. Prints a status table. Called at the start of CLAUDE.md step 1. |
| `templates/.gitattributes` (NEW) | `* text=auto eol=lf` to normalize line endings. Fixes the Windows CRLF case. |

### C.3 PII guard (expansion — in blast radius)

**Why:** `resume.md` is tracked in git. `setup-config.json` holds email. If a user pushes to a public repo, their phone / address / DOB / email leaks. Review flagged this as a privacy blocker.

**Taste decision surfaced at gate** (see below) on how aggressive to be: pre-commit hook vs README warning vs gitignore by default.

| File | Change (minimum) |
|------|--------|
| `.gitignore` | Add `resume.md` — users who want it tracked can remove this line. Make "your career data stays local by default" the default safe stance. |
| CLAUDE.md | Explicit warning in step 1: "Your resume will stay on your machine. Push `setup-config.json` to GitHub — that's safe (no phone/address). Do NOT push `resume.md` unless you're comfortable making that public." |
| `scripts/doctor.mjs` | Scan for patterns: US phone `(\d{3}\)\s*\d{3}-\d{4}`, emails that aren't in `setup-config.json`, `gsk_` tokens, long digit sequences (DOB-like). Warn on staged files. |

### C.4 Single source of truth for the paste-prompt

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `setup.js:192` `DEMO_PROMPT_TEXT` | Move to `templates/paste-prompt.txt` (plain text). `setup.js` reads it at build time. `README.md` hero references it via `scripts/sync-readme-prompt.mjs`. |
| `scripts/sync-readme-prompt.mjs` (NEW) | Reads `templates/paste-prompt.txt`, finds `<!-- BEGIN:PASTE_PROMPT --> ... <!-- END:PASTE_PROMPT -->` in README.md, replaces. Same pattern as BEGIN:FULL_HIGHLIGHTS. |

### Dogfood test (Agam or stranger)

1. Click "Use this template" on the GitHub repo.
2. Clone locally. No spaces in path.
3. `node --version` ≥ 18.
4. Open in Claude Code.
5. Follow CLAUDE.md from step 1. Use throwaway persona.
6. Track: where Claude Code asks something unexpected, where wizard fails, how many iterations the coaching loop needs, whether eval-custom.json gets generated meaningfully.
7. Deploy to Netlify. Visit live URL. Test on mobile.
8. Report: every friction point. Fix each before public promotion.

## Failure modes registry

| Failure mode | Layer | Detection | Mitigation |
|--------------|-------|-----------|------------|
| Default prompt regresses on merge | Template | CI (A.5) | Block PR |
| Groq deprecates a model | Runtime | `check-models` (A.4) + CI | Fail setup + PR |
| User pushes `resume.md` with PII | Privacy | `.gitignore` default + `doctor.mjs` scan (C.3) | Default-safe + active warn |
| Eval uses broken rubric | Test | Rubric fix (A.1) | Strengthen per-category checks |
| Coaching loop oscillates | Wizard | Best-so-far snapshot (B.3) | Revert + iteration cap |
| Groq rate-limit during coaching | Wizard | Exponential backoff (A.2) + batch delay | Backoff + resume |
| Fresh-clone Node mismatch | Install | `package.json` engines (A.6) + `doctor.mjs` | Fail fast |
| Windows CRLF corrupts hydration | Install | `.gitattributes` (C.2) | Normalize at checkout |
| User supplies GROQ key with quotes | Install | `check-env.mjs` regex validation (A.6) | Strip + warn |
| `system-prompt.md` missing BEGIN/END markers | Template | HARD ERROR in `setup.js` (A.3) | Fail setup, pointer to CLAUDE.md step 2 |
| `eval-custom.json` commits to public repo | Privacy | `.gitignore` default (B.2) | Gitignored |

## Dream state delta (where this plan leaves us vs 12-month ideal)

**Today:** Agam's demo. Fragile. Rubric lies to us.

**After this plan:** A template that survives strangers. 12/12 measured honestly on all 4 prod models. CI blocks regressions. PII doesn't leak by default. Coaching loop is the portfolio hook.

**12-month ideal:** 100+ deploys. LinkedIn-integrated import ("paste your LinkedIn URL, we scrape resume.md"). Agent-to-agent negotiation protocol (recruiter-AI calls `/.well-known/ai-resume.json` with specific queries). Analytics dashboard for the resume holder ("14 visitors asked about your voice AI work this week"). Paid tier for custom domains.

**Delta this plan closes:** ~15% of the ideal. It gets us from "demo" to "real template." That's enough — the 12-month ideal is a direction, not a ship bar.

## Cross-phase themes

- **Review found that the plan as stated was insufficient.** User's 3 tracks covered the what-you-see-is-broken work. Review found the what-you-don't-see-is-broken work: rubric bugs, single-model eval, no CI, PII leaks. All three surfaced expansions are inside blast radius (same files, same user journey) — classic Boil the Lake.
- **Portfolio play matters.** Every expansion was evaluated against "does this strengthen the portfolio hook (AI-coding-fluent workflow that coaches itself)?" CI does. PII guard does. Multi-model matrix does. These aren't polish; they are demonstrations of taste.
- **Template quality compounds.** Every hour spent making the default prompt pass honestly is an hour saved for every future user. Agam is user #1 — also user #N.

## Taste Decisions (surfaced at final gate)

| # | Decision | Option A (recommended) | Option B | Why A wins | Why B might win |
|---|----------|------------------------|----------|------------|------------------|
| T1 | HIRE rule location | Stricter eval check only (require `/\d/` + highlight token) | Eval check + system-prompt rule | Keeps prompt terse under 100-token cap; review concurs | Belt-and-suspenders if model ignores tight prompt |
| T2 | `resume.md` default | Gitignored by default, opt-in tracking | Tracked by default with prominent README warning | Safer default; GitHub template users often miss warnings | Users might like shipping resume.md as single source of truth |
| T3 | PII guard implementation | `scripts/doctor.mjs` warn-only scan | `husky` + pre-commit hook (hard block) | Less friction, no new dep | Actually blocks the leak instead of warning |
| T4 | CI required for merge | PR check, blocking | Warning only | Protects template integrity against careless commits | Agam-only repo today; blocking feels heavy |
| T5 | Coaching loop visibility | Wizard shows iteration count + per-test diff | Silent loop with final summary | Learnability — this IS the portfolio hook, show it off | Cleaner UX |
